messages:
Zoe: dropping a fresh iteration of the compact rollout row focused on A/B variants and the restore flow. need quick feedback on microcopy and keyboard affordances before we hand to eng. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/zzz/rollout-compact-v1 (page: variant-rows)

Priya: nice! first thought: the variant label 'B-test-2' is too noisy. recommend normalized variant names like 'Variant B' and a subtle sublabel for experiment id. keeps row readable.

Marc: agree on name hygiene. also want to flag the confidence metric — we show a small badge '80% conf' but we should clarify what that means in tooltip: "statistical confidence of uplift vs baseline".

Abby: accessibility: badges must have text alternatives. e.g., visually show '80% conf' but include sr-only text "Confidence: 80%". Also ensure badges meet 4.5:1 contrast at 12px. current yellow fails.

Zoe: good catch. i'll update badges to darker amber and add sr-only spans.

Priya: copy for rollback/restore: current menu item is "Revert variant" which confused PMs in last usability session. Suggest menu copy: "Stop variant" or "Restore baseline" depending on context. For a full rollback to baseline, use "Restore baseline". For pausing experiment, use "Pause variant".

Marc: from implementation POV we have two server actions: pause traffic to variant (keep data) vs restore baseline (shift 100% traffic back). frontend should surface both and the modal copy should explicitly state traffic implications.

Zoe: proposed modal copy for Restore baseline: header: "Restore baseline?" body: "This will route 100% of new traffic to the baseline version. Ongoing variant sessions will complete." confirm CTA: "Restore baseline" secondary: "Cancel"

Abby: keyboard + screen reader note: make primary CTA first in tab order, add aria-label with version id, and an aria-live polite region that states the change once complete: "Baseline restored. Traffic: 100% to v3.2.1". Also trap focus while modal open.

Priya: UX nit: we currently show big traffic bars for every row in compact mode. For rows under 3% traffic let's replace bars with a tiny dot + percentage to reduce clutter.

Marc: yes, and for A/B results show delta with +/- and color for direction. If we show p-values, be careful about misuse; prefer plain-language summary like 'Likely uplift' / 'No significant change'.

Zoe: plan for row layout: variant name, small badge (variant/baseline), timestamp, compact traffic indicator (bar or dot), chevron to expand (metrics + diffs). Expand panel includes sparkline, confidence, error rate, and rollout controls.

Abby: keyboard interactions: Enter to expand, Esc to close, Left/Right to move between variants in the expanded panel, and Ctrl+Enter to confirm restore (add guard). Please document these in the interaction spec.

Priya: tiny copy nit on expand CTA: "Show details" vs "Open"  prefer "Show details" (more discoverable).

Marc: performance: virtualization required once a customer has >200 versions. Spike RED-3366 suggested. ensure expanded panels keep DOM nodes mounted while focused.

UXBot: Ticket created RED-3366: "Compact rollout rows: variant naming, badges contrast, modal ARIA, virtualization spike" 44c; https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/RED-3366

Zoe: action items: normalize variant labels, adjust badge contrast + sr-only text, update modal copy + ARIA, change tiny-traffic visual for <3%, and add keybinding doc. i'll update figma and reupload by EOD. thanks all! :sparkles:
